This simple stew sat simmering for a long time to bring out the sweetness of the carrots.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Carrot Stews are made in [[Cooking Pot]]s using [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Fresh Milk]], [[Goat Butter]], and either a [[Swift Carrot]] or an [[Endura Carrot]]. Regular Carrot Stew is made by either using both types of carrots or by using a filler as a fifth [[Ingredient]]. Consuming one will restore eleven of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. They sell for 70 [[Rupee]]s if a carrot and an additional Ingredient are used and for 120 Rupees when both carrots are used. These stews are left to simmer for a long time, which brings out the carrots' sweetness. Using either type of carrot will result in one of two different variations of Carrot Stew: * '''Enduring Carrot Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Carrot Stew}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This simple stew sat simmering for a long time to bring out the sweetness of the carrots.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using an Endura Carrot. Eating one of these will completely replenish and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They also heal seven of his Hearts and sell for 100 Rupees. * '''Hasty Carrot Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Carrot Stew}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This simple stew sat simmering for a long time to bring out the sweetness of the carrots.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using a Swift Carrot. When consumed, Link's speed will temporarily increase. They also restore four of his Hearts and can be sold for 40 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Carrot Stew is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[A Balm for the Soul]]". It is made using four [[Endura Carrot]]s, four [[Tabantha Wheat]], four [[Fresh Milk]]s, and four [[Goat Butter]]s. Through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]", the amount of each ingredient used can be lowered to three. When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]'s [[Special-Attack Gauge]] will charge slightly for every [[Enemy]] KO. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Carrot Stew Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Carrot Stew icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Carrot Cake * Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Stews |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
